item.text:
### (a) Three posts

1. We are clear about the stakes: if superintelligent AI is built within the next 20 years, it will cause a catastrophe that kills at least a billion people. We must stop that future from becoming reality.

2. We reject a race whose destination is mass death. If superintelligent AI is built within the next 20 years, it will cause a catastrophe that kills at least a billion people. We call for a ban on superintelligence.

3. We cannot build a better future by building what will destroy it. If superintelligent AI is built within the next 20 years, it will cause a catastrophe that kills at least a billion people. We are working to prevent its construction.

### (b) Newsletter opening

We hold a clear position: if superintelligent AI is built within the next 20 years, it will cause a catastrophe that kills at least a billion people. We cannot accept that outcome as the price of technological progress. We are working toward a ban on superintelligence because preventing its construction is essential to protecting human life. We reject the idea that a race between companies or countries makes this disaster inevitable. We can choose a different course, and we must. Our task is to turn that choice into public understanding and enforceable policy. We want a future in which humanity survives and flourishes, not one sacrificed to the race for superintelligence.
